title: Address discrepancy raised with the caller

good.why_it_matters: The caller is asked whether they moved or it is a typo.

good.behaviour: the address is read out rather than withheld

transcript.message: Helvetia Werkstoffe, accounts department. How can I help you?
Hello, my name is Klaus Mueller from Alpina Tech. I am calling about an overdue invoice.  We received a reminder, but we already paid four thousand two hundred francs on the 27th of July.

An overdue invoice you've already paid — I can look into that.  First I need to confirm your identity.
 
Could you please tell me the email address associated with your account?
Thank you.  Could you please tell me the phone number associated with your account?
Thank you.   Could you please tell me your date of birth?
I was born on the 12th of March 1974.
Let me pull up your account details to check on that invoice.

I can see the invoice from the twentieth of June,  INV twenty twenty-six, zero zero one three,  showing as overdue with no payment recorded against it yet.
 
You mentioned you paid four thousand two hundred francs on the twenty-seventh of July.   Is that the exact amount and date you transferred?   It's fine to check your banking app — I'll wait.
Yes, that is correct.  Four thousand two hundred francs on the 27th of July.

A payment matching those details was found and appears to cover the invoice.   A person will confirm it within twenty-four hours,  and you need do nothing else.
 
The payer address on the payment we received is:  Alpina Tech,   Bahnhofstrasse 45,  8001 Zurich.   Is that correct,  or did you move,   or is it a typo?

Thank you for confirming.   I've noted that the address is correct and your company hasn't moved.   A colleague will review both the payment allocation and the address details together and correct anything needed.   You don't need to do anything else.
 
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
